title: Real lateral pitch from the mesh PPM versus the nominal 3.24 um pitch, checkpoint A, same ROIs as phases 13-14
status_before_scores: no real-pitch volume prepared and no real-pitch score computed; nominal scores and all ink labels already read in phases 13-14
label_of_results: exploratory: the labels of all six fragments were read before this protocol
unchanged_from_nominal: patch centres, direction, W2 window and depth coordinates read from the committed phase13/14 prepare manifests; 1024 x 1024 output px; layers trilinear; inference phase11_z_frag4.run, both orders

pitch.rule: per ROI, medians of |dP/dcol| and |dP/drow| (CT voxels per UV pixel) of the published mesh PPM, finite differences on a 16 px lattice inside the nominal ROI box and the mask, pixels with a zero PPM entry skipped
pitch.output_step: native UV px per output px, per axis: 2.215 / (3.24 * pitch); output grid centred on the patch centre, as the nominal one
pitch.reported: pitch IQR and median |cos| between dP/dcol and dP/drow (shear, not corrected)

labels: same inklabels.png as phases 12-14, sampled nearest neighbour on the real-pitch grid
support_and_inclusion: as phases 13-14: mask eroded 16 output px, Hann weight >= 25 % of maximum; a ROI enters the comparison only if both its nominal and real-pitch versions hold >= 1000 valid positive and >= 1000 valid negative pixels

primary.statistic: delta = ROC-AUC(Z_out, real pitch) - ROC-AUC(Z_out, nominal) per included ROI; mean over included ROIs
primary.interval: ROI bootstrap (resample included ROIs with replacement), 9999 draws, seed 216, percentile 95 %
primary.decision: adopt the real pitch as the default preparation if the lower 95 % bound of the mean delta > 0 and no fragment has a mean delta < -0.02; otherwise keep the nominal pitch

secondary_reported_without_decision: delta of the share of valid pixels with Z_out > 0.5
per-fragment pooled ROC-AUC(Z_out) at the real pitch
Spearman between |log(pitch_col * pitch_row)| + |log(pitch_col / pitch_row)| and delta
not_allowed_after_scores: changing the pitch rule, ROIs, support, inclusion, statistic, interval or decision
reporting a subset of ROIs or fragments
